decisions.reason: As a software-based secure second-channel offer that fits the firm's core identity and communication strategy, it likely remains inexpensive to keep while still supporting cross-channel ecosystem opportunities.

A multi-layer end-to-end security architecture is highly consistent with the firm's core cryptographic capabilities and platform direction, so management would be reluctant to abandon it absent clear failure.

The QR-code-based hardware token is less aligned with the firm's move toward scalable app-based security ecosystems and likely imposes higher support and lifecycle costs, so the option value now appears limited.
The compliance suite remains adjacent to the firm's regulatory-security strengths and can be kept as a relatively low-cost option until demand in this niche becomes more fully revealed.
